title: Stir-Fried Dolce with Gorgonzola and Ethiopian Cheese
description: A unique and savory fusion of Chinese and Italian flavors, combining the sweetness of Dolce and the creaminess of Gorgonzola with the tanginess of Ethiopian Cheese.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add the Dolce and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the Gorgonzola and Ethiopian cheese and stir-fry until they start to melt.
Pour in the soy sauce and sesame oil, and stir-fry for another minute.
Serve immediately, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped scallions if desired.
